title: Use FormatTimeCallable in the RichHandler docstring
impact: Readers looking up the log_time_format callable type by the name in the parameter documentation are directed to a name that differs from the signature.
expected_behavior: The RichHandler parameter documentation names FormatTimeCallable, matching the constructor annotation.
actual_behavior: The RichHandler docstring names TimeFormatterCallable, whereas the constructor uses FormatTimeCallable.
